subject: Complete Your Registration for the Hackathon
body:
Hi Builder,

You are receiving this because you've taken the first step to join us for the **second edition** of the Berlin Robotics & AI Hackathon, on **November 21–22, 2026**.

Hacklab is on a mission to completely bridge the gaps between companies, investors, and the brightest technical minds in Europe. 

### 📋 What Happens Next?

Since spots for this hackathon are strictly limited, we want to make sure we curate the most dynamic and capable teams possible. Here’s what you need to do:

* **Fill Out the Mandatory Form:** Your Luma / Eventbrite ticket alone is not enough to participate. Since we’ve received a large number of registrations, please fill out this mandatory form to enter the selection process: [https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8](https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8)

* **More Updates:** We will be dropping regular updates right here in your inbox. We will share insights into the tech stacks, reveal specific hardware, and drop important event logistics.

### 🔗 Stay Connected in Real-Time

We are posting live updates, ecosystem news, and behind-the-scenes content directly on our brand channel.

👉 [Follow Hacklab on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hack-lab-robotics/) 👈

The Hacklab Team
